label: bitbucket pull request
title: {org}/{repo} PR {num}
prompt: Review the pull request at {url}. The worktree is already on its branch.
notes: The same thing as a github pull request with a different spelling in the path, which is exactly why the host is a field of its own rather than an assumption. The fetch is the built-in forge one, which the hub answers.

label: bitbucket issue
title: {org}/{repo} issue {num}
notes: The trailing slug bitbucket adds after the number is allowed and ignored. The fetch is the built-in forge one, which the hub answers.

label: bitbucket branch
title: {org}/{repo} {ref}
prompt:
Continue the work on branch {ref} of {org}/{repo} ({url}).

Read the log against the default branch first, then say what the branch is doing and what looks unfinished.
notes: The branch page, /branch/<name>. A /src/<name>/<path> url mixes the branch and a file path, so it is not matched.
